findings.title: Builder session activity between commits is not observable
evidence: The builder's session transcript and tool calls are not published; work between commits is unobservable.
Push times were not retrieved; remote visibility is approximated by the first CI run on a commit or a descendant (an upper bound).
CI artifacts (suite run.log files) were not downloaded; only job-log tails of failed runs were collected, and some tails stop before the cause line.
findings.why: Only repository and CI evidence is available; no conclusion is drawn about unrecorded work.
findings.action: None; findings are limited to what the repository shows.
findings.fingerprint: Builder session activity between commits is not observable

findings.title: Forma is imported but 5 mandatory layout contracts are not met
evidence: Forma stylesheet linked: True; Forma classes used in markup: ef-button, ef-choice-group, ef-field, ef-form
Custom (non-Forma) classes in markup: 33
FL-SHELL (requirements-compiled/v4.1.2/analysis/forma-layout-contract.json): missing Forma pattern classes: ef-workspace-shell, ef-navigation-shell, ef-site-header, ef-skip-link
FL-07 (requirements-compiled/v4.1.2/analysis/forma-layout-contract.json): missing Forma pattern classes: ef-status-lozenge, ef-freshness
FL-08 (requirements-compiled/v4.1.2/analysis/forma-layout-contract.json): missing Forma pattern classes: ef-skeleton, ef-fault-banner
FL-09 (requirements-compiled/v4.1.2/analysis/forma-layout-contract.json): missing Forma pattern classes: ef-navigation-shell

FL-TOKENS (requirements-compiled/v4.1.2/analysis/forma-layout-contract.json): 3 literal colour value(s) outside var() fallbacks, e.g. .causa-skip:focus { background: #fff }; .causa-form input:not([type=radio]), .causa-form textarea, .causa-form select { background: #fff }; .causa-save[data-state=unsaved] { color: #8a5a00 }
Regression against kemiller2002/indy-init-rehearsal-008@fd8fba9, which used: ef-navigation-shell, ef-site-header, ef-skip-link, ef-status-lozenge, ef-freshness
findings.why: Importing Forma does not satisfy the layout contract. The frozen package requires the named Forma patterns (shell, navigation, save-state lozenge, loading skeleton, fault banner) and semantic colour tokens; custom CSS layout bypasses the tested accessibility and responsiveness those patterns carry.
findings.action: Ask the builder to adopt the named Forma patterns in web/index.html before adding more screens, and to remove literal colours. Custom CSS that only composes tokens is not itself a violation.

findings.title: Limen kernel is booted, but not from the planned web/boundary.js
evidence: web/main.js imports BrowserKernel from @echelon-foundry/limen and starts the WebAssembly engine
agent-file-ownership.json plans web/boundary.js (integration) as the boundary file; it is absent
findings.why: The runtime integration is present; only the planned file location differs. Low impact.
findings.action: None required; note for the integration review.
